title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (powershell) — review required
description: In powershell, naming MD5 (Get-FileHash f -Algorithm MD5) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The powershell-specific remedy is selecting -Algorithm SHA256.
applicability: powershell codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
